jobs.prompt: tools/watch-server.mjs serves /assets/<name> only from a flat, preloaded listing of the asset folder (loadAssets) and its TYPES table has only .html, .css and .js. The Command Center now needs the vendored files under tools/watch-assets/vendor/ (fonts/*.woff2, fluent-emoji/*.webp, and the existing vendored js/css), requested as /assets/vendor/fonts/x.woff2 etc.; today they 404. Fix: (1) add to TYPES: .woff2 font/woff2, .webp image/webp, .png image/png, .svg image/svg+xml (svg served with the same security headers). (2) In loadAssets, after the flat files, also preload the vendor/ subtree recursively (only regular files, no symlinks: use readdir withFileTypes and skip entry.isSymbolicLink() and anything not isFile(); only extensions present in TYPES; skip LICENSE files and VENDOR.json), keyed by the forward-slash relative path from the asset folder, e.g. "vendor/fonts/oxanium-latin-wght-normal.woff2". (3) sendAsset keeps its exact-key lookup (no path joining from the URL, so traversal stays impossible); just make sure a key with slashes works. Keep everything else unchanged. Tests in NEW tests/watch-server-vendor-assets.test.mjs (first import: import './_isolate-config.mjs';): start createWatchServer the way existing watch-server tests do, request /assets/vendor/fonts/oxanium-latin-wght-normal.woff2 (200, content-type font/woff2, body equals the file), /assets/vendor/fluent-emoji/robot_56.webp (200, image/webp), /assets/vendor/VENDOR.json (404), /assets/vendor/fonts/LICENSE-oxanium (404), /assets/vendor/../watch-server.mjs and /assets/%2e%2e/x (404), and a symlink placed in a temp asset dir copy pointing outside is not served.
